name: ledgerflow
description: A local-first event-driven financial operations simulator.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ledgerflow/contracts && npm run build -w @ledgerflow/ledger-domain && npm run db:generate -w @ledgerflow/ledger-service && npm run build -w @ledgerflow/ledger-service && npm run build -w @ledgerflow/settlement-worker && npm run build -w @ledgerflow/api-gateway && npm run build -w @ledgerflow/web
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @ledgerflow/contracts && npm run build -w @ledgerflow/ledger-domain && npm run db:generate -w @ledgerflow/ledger-service
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,ledger,worker,web -c cyan,green,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @ledgerflow/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @ledgerflow/ledger-service" "npm run dev -w @ledgerflow/settlement-worker" "npm run dev -w @ledgerflow/web"
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high
